slides.title:
Own the arrival.
Own the margin.
slides.subtitle: A silent, all-electric hydrofoil transfer fleet — branded by Minor, owned end to end.

quads.label: Where you are today
quads.text: More than 100 coastal and island resorts — Anantara, Avani, NH Collection, Oaks and Tivoli — where the guest journey is defined by water.

quads.label: What you’re up against
quads.text: The signature arrival is still a diesel speedboat or a weather-bound seaplane: loud, fume-heavy, and run by someone else.

quads.label: Where Navier fits
quads.text: A branded electric hydrofoil fleet you control end to end — silent arrivals, inter-resort hops and curated excursions.

quads.label: Why now
quads.text: Your coastal portfolio is scaling fast — and the electric foiling fleet is already flying in the Maldives today.

slides.words: First class, finally on the water
slides.body: The Navier N30 is the world’s most advanced electric hydrofoil. It rises clear of the water on foils — so the ride is silent, smooth and completely emission-free.

slides.title: The last mile breaks the spell
bullets: Your spaces are calm, refined and sustainable — then the transfer arrives.
A diesel boat or a weather-bound seaplane: loud, fumes, fixed schedules.
It’s the first thing your guest feels, and the one part still off-brand.
And the revenue flows straight to an outside operator.

cols.head: Cost
cols.text: Electric running costs and a fleet you own — so the transfer revenue stays inside the portfolio instead of leaking to third parties.

cols.head: Convenience
cols.text: On the guest’s schedule, not the weather’s. Longer operating hours, far fewer cancellations, one simple booking.

cols.head: Comfort
cols.text: No engine noise, no fumes, no sea-sickness — guests glide above the water in a calm, glass-walled cabin.

slides.body: Foiling above the chop, the N30 removes the noise, the spray and the motion. Guests arrive as relaxed as they leave.

items.note: Covers nearly every resort transfer in your portfolio today.
Resort to airport in a fraction of the usual time.
Around 90% less energy than a conventional boat.
No weather days, no sea-sickness, dependable schedules.

cols.head: Gateway arrivals
cols.text: Airport or city pier straight to the resort jetty — the branded first impression, in your colours.

cols.head: Inter-resort hops
cols.text: Connect your properties within a cluster — one fleet, many stays, guests moving easily between resorts.

cols.head: Curated excursions
cols.text: Sunset cruises, island-hopping and private charters — a brand-new on-water revenue line.

slides.title: Proven, and trusted
bullets: Already flying in the Maldives — the platform is live, not a concept.
Engineered with U.S. Navy partners, with no single point of failure.
Chosen by leading names in luxury — Four Seasons, Ferragamo and Oscar de la Renta.
Nearly every resort transfer is within today’s range — ready now.

slides.name: United Arab Emirates
slides.subtitle: Palm Jumeirah · Abu Dhabi · Sir Bani Yas · Ras Al Khaimah · Sharjah

blocks.label: What you have here
blocks.text: Eleven properties across the Emirates — three on the Palm (Anantara, NH Collection, Avani+), plus the Sir Bani Yas island trio, Eastern Mangroves and Mina Al Arab in Ras Al Khaimah.

blocks.label: How we’d connect it
blocks.text: Branded gateway runs from Dubai Marina and the airport to the Palm crescents; island transfers out to Sir Bani Yas; a premium hop along the Abu Dhabi–Ras Al Khaimah coast.

blocks.label: What it unlocks
blocks.text: Silent Palm arrivals · island-resort access without the long road · sunset charters on Dubai’s water.

slides.name: Maldives
slides.subtitle: Six island resorts across the atolls

blocks.label: What you have here
blocks.text: Anantara Dhigu, Veli, Kihavah, Naladhu, Niyama and Avani+ Fares — the purest case of all, where every guest already arrives by water or air.

blocks.label: How we’d connect it
blocks.text: Airport-to-island transfers from the regional atoll airports straight to the resort jetty, plus quiet island hops between resorts within each atoll.

blocks.label: What it unlocks
blocks.text: A calm foiling arrival in place of the diesel launch · longer operating hours than seaplanes · island-hopping between Minor resorts.

slides.name: Thailand
slides.subtitle: Phuket · Phang Nga · Krabi · Koh Samui · Hua Hin

blocks.label: What you have here
blocks.text: Twenty properties across the Andaman and the Gulf — including Anantara Koh Yao Yai, reachable only by boat — the largest captive transfer base in the portfolio.

blocks.label: How we’d connect it
blocks.text: Phuket gateway piers across Phang Nga Bay to the island resorts; Samui–Phangan hops in the Gulf; Hua Hin and Krabi coastal runs.

blocks.label: What it unlocks
blocks.text: A branded crossing to Koh Yao Yai · monsoon-resilient schedules · excursions through the limestone bays.

slides.name: Mediterranean Europe
slides.subtitle: Amalfi · Venice · Côte d’Azur · Adriatic · Algarve

blocks.label: What you have here
blocks.text: Sixteen coastal properties — Amalfi, Venice, Nice, the Trieste–Portorož–Umag Adriatic spine, the Algarve and the Canaries.

blocks.label: How we’d connect it
blocks.text: Planned coastal links along the Amalfi shore, across the Venice lagoon and along the three-border Adriatic spine — phased in as the clusters come online.

blocks.label: What it unlocks
blocks.text: Glamorous arrivals along the riviera · lagoon transfers without the traffic · a signature on Europe’s most photographed coastlines.

slides.name: Australia (coastal)
slides.subtitle: Gold Coast · Sunshine Coast · Brisbane · Cairns & Port Douglas

blocks.label: What you have here
blocks.text: Twenty coastal properties — anchored on the Gold Coast and extending to the Sunshine Coast, Brisbane / Moreton Bay and the Great Barrier Reef gateway at Cairns and Port Douglas.

blocks.label: How we’d connect it
blocks.text: Marina-to-resort runs along the Gold Coast; Moreton Bay island hops; reef-gateway transfers from Cairns and Port Douglas, phased with the cluster.

blocks.label: What it unlocks
blocks.text: Calm coastal transfers · reef and island day-trips · a premium on-water line for the Australian portfolio.

cols.head: Navier brings
cols.text: The silent foiling fleet, captain training, maintenance and certification, and the operating playbook already proven in the Maldives.

cols.head: Minor brings
cols.text: 100+ coastal properties, a captive guest base, jetty access, and the brand standard for luxury arrival.

cols.head: Together
cols.text: A branded Minor foiling transfer tier — gateway arrivals, inter-resort hops and excursions — starting in Phuket and Bali, then the Palm and the Maldives.

slides.title:
Own the arrival.
Own the margin.
slides.body: From Phuket’s headlands to the Palm’s crescents to the Maldives atolls — a silent, zero-emission arrival that turns every guest’s last mile into a Minor Hotels signature, and keeps the revenue inside the portfolio.
